subject: process.records

recordTypes.summary: An external selection record that binds the governed process-capture definition.

fields.summary: The exact human-readable process policy title.

content.summary: The governed rules live in the selected Process Context definition artifact.

recordTypes.summary: An external selection record that binds the governed process-review definition.

fields.summary: The exact human-readable process review policy title.

content.summary: The governed lenses and report-only rules live in the selected Process Context definition artifact.

recordTypes.summary: A reusable definition of repeatable work, distinct from any execution of that definition.

fields.summary: The exact process definition name.
The definition lifecycle state, separate from adoption and priority.
The exact configured cadence option for the process definition.
The exact configured process category when one is supplied.
Exact configured process tags, never invented from free-form requests.
The separate process adoption stage, never encoded in Status.
The separate process priority, never encoded in Status.
Exact role resource identities that own process logic.
Exact optional service resource identities resolved before preparation.
Every exact directory role used by the process definition.
Exact policy standards whose required claims govern this definition.
Portable record types whose current schemas must be included in a complete process review.
Normalized operator-checkable controls the process definition explicitly declares.

content.summary: The deterministic process body contains roles, initialization, role-bounded steps, work-items, exceptions, and close-out declarations.

recordTypes.summary: A named responsibility and capability bundle referenced by process definitions and executions.

fields.summary: The exact role directory name.
The declared capability vocabulary owned by the role definition.

content.summary: Optional role definition detail remains provider-neutral markdown.

recordTypes.summary: A service catalog identity that may be related to one or more process definitions.

fields.summary: The exact service catalog name.

content.summary: Optional service description remains provider-neutral markdown.

recordTypes.summary: One execution of a process definition with its own state, outcome, inputs, outputs, and proof.

fields.summary: The exact run identity visible to an operator.
The immutable process definition resource identity executed by this run.
The explicit execution state of this run.
The explicit observed run outcome when one exists.
Normalized controls and success-state facts actually observed on this run.

content.summary: The run body retains exact inputs, outputs, and proof without changing the process definition.

recordTypes.summary: A rules-first policy source explicitly related to the process definitions it governs.

fields.summary: The exact policy standard title.
Exact process definition resource identities governed by this policy.
Normalized operator-checkable controls required by this policy standard.

content.summary: The exact governed rules used when reviewing a process definition.

limitations: A process definition is not a process run, and definition work-items are never Task records.
Current provider options, relation identities, and templates must be observed through configured capabilities; Context never fabricates them.
Preparation, private review, or contained evidence grants no approval, execution, provider-write, readiness, verification, or health authority.
